symptom: Result table has fewer rows than the job fetched
likely_cause: Per-row failures swallowed silently; conditional writeback skipped rows
diagnostic: Log fetched/decided/failed counts per batch; assert decided+failed==fetched at end
fix: Route failed rows to a failed_rows sink with raw response; never drop silently

symptom: Batch job dies midway and restart reprocesses everything
likely_cause: No resume logic; candidate query refetches all rows
diagnostic: Check candidate query for anti-join against results table
fix: Fetch only unprocessed rows: anti-join results on (source_id model_version); insert per batch not per run

symptom: Duplicate rows in results after re-run
likely_cause: Append-only insert with no idempotency key
diagnostic: GROUP BY source_id HAVING count()>1 on results table
fix: Key writes by (source_id model_version); use ReplacingMergeTree or upsert semantics

symptom: DAG task fails repeatedly on LLM API step
likely_cause: Provider transient errors or timeouts kill the task; no backoff
diagnostic: Read task logs for timeout/5xx/rate-limit strings
fix: Per-request timeout + bounded retries with exponential backoff; task retries>=2; defer transient failures to the next scheduled run

symptom: Malformed or empty JSON from the model
likely_cause: Output schema not enforced; temperature>0; prompt drift
diagnostic: Log raw responses for failed parses; count parse-failure rate
fix: Validate schema per row; retry once on violation then quarantine; temperature=0 for classification

symptom: Model answers Unknown / refuses to pick a label
likely_cause: Open-ended output field; label set not closed in the signature
diagnostic: Grep outputs for values outside the enum
fix: Enumerate allowed labels in the output field; validate against the enum; forbid Unknown in the instruction

symptom: Legitimate inputs rejected for containing another language
diagnostic: Sample rejected rows; count ones containing brand/model terms
fix: Never reject on foreign-script presence alone; require structural violation or route borderline rows to the LLM

symptom: Cost far above estimate on full run
likely_cause: No sample-first cost extrapolation; retries multiply tokens
diagnostic: Compare tokens-per-row on sample vs full run
fix: Run 100-1000 row sample first; extrapolate; add hard budget guard that aborts the run

diagnostic: Diff outputs of two runs on same input slice
fix: temperature=0; log prompt_version and model name with every row

likely_cause: Jobs load hardcoded run ids or local paths
diagnostic: Grep job configs for runs:/ or file paths
fix: Load models:/<name>@<alias> only; promote via alias flip

symptom: Model loads locally but fails in the batch job
likely_cause: Companion files (label maps category lists) read from repo paths not bundled
diagnostic: Run the loaded model in a clean directory
fix: Bundle all companion files as model artifacts; resolve paths relative to the artifact dir

symptom: Systematic label errors discovered by humans
likely_cause: No audit loop; corrections applied ad hoc
fix: Export low-confidence/disagreement rows to CSV; human or judge-LLM review; keyed correction writeback; encode repeated mistake classes as rules

likely_cause: Judge prompt only critiques without committing
fix: Force judge to output verdict + suggested_label + reason; audit judge on known-bad seed examples

symptom: Rule layer and prompt drift apart
likely_cause: Same policy encoded twice (rules in code and prose in prompt)
diagnostic: Diff rule behavior vs prompt instructions on shared cases
fix: Single source of truth: rules decide what rules can; prompt handles only the remainder
